Investor overview

One Solana app for trading, launching and money

Ryntra puts Solana's best venues behind one review, one route and one receipt — and shares its revenue with the people who grow it.

Request an introOpen the product

The problem

Solana's best products live in different places

01

Scattered venues

Swaps, stock tokens, launches, perps and pools each live in a separate app with its own rules.

02

Hidden costs

People sign raw transactions without seeing the route, the fees or what will actually happen.

03

Markets that fade

A token launches, and its creator is left without the tools, fees or liquidity to keep the market alive.

What Ryntra does

Review before signing, a receipt after

One app

Trade, invest, launch, perps, pools and money from one Solana wallet.

Non-custodial

The person's wallet signs every action; Ryntra never holds a key.

Built on Solana's best

Jupiter, Meteora, Phoenix and Squads do the execution; Ryntra builds the experience around them.

An assistant, not an adviser

Ryntra explains markets and checks plans; the decision stays with the person.

Why Solana

Solana-first, end to end

01

Speed people feel

Quotes in a fraction of a second and confirmations fast enough for a trading terminal.

02

The best venues

Deep liquidity and launch, perps and treasury primitives Ryntra builds on instead of rebuilding.

A phone in the pocket

An Android app in the Solana dApp Store and one-tap Seeker Connect.

04

One wallet

One Solana wallet for every product; money from other networks arrives by deposit.

How Ryntra earns

Revenue from real activity, published in the product

StreamHow it is charged
Trading0.1% on major tokens · 0.5% trending · 1% new and meme tokens · 0% stable to stable
Tokenized stocks0.25%–0.5% per trade, by issuer
Token launch48% of every curve fee · 60% of the graduation fee · a locked position in every graduated pool
Ryntra assistantCredits bought in USDC; free credits every day
Perps on Phoenix0.02% of the filled size on taker orders, on top of Phoenix's own fee
PredictionsA fee is set when real money opens

Trader rewards are paid from the fee Ryntra receives — 50% cashback and friends' shares. Creator partners' shares are counted within a 40% cap per pool and paid after Ryntra's first test payout.

Growth engine

Creators earn from their market

Partners bring creators

20% → 10% of Ryntra's part of each creator's pool; payouts open next.

Traders bring friends

50% cashback and 10–30% on friends' trades, claimed to the wallet.

Principles & disclosures

What we do not claim

  • No profit, price or yield promises — for Ryntra or its users.
  • Usage is published only when counted from the chain by a written rule.
  • A stock token is not a share; access depends on the issuer.
  • Predictions money opens only after its live check.
  • Projections, if any, are labelled as projections with their method.
